name: python-educrs
description: Free, interactive, offline-first Python course for absolute beginners — python.educrs.com

scripts.build: pnpm --filter run build && PUBLIC_RUN_ORIGIN=${PUBLIC_RUN_ORIGIN:-https://sandbox.invalid} pnpm --filter web build
scripts.build:e2e: APP_ORIGIN=http://localhost:4321 PREVIEW_ORIGIN_REGEX='^http://localhost:4325$' FRAME_ANCESTORS_EXTRA='http://localhost:4325 http://localhost:4326' pnpm --filter run build && PUBLIC_RUN_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:4322 pnpm --filter web build
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:concepts && pnpm test:content && pnpm test:parity && pnpm lint:deps && pnpm test:boundaries && pnpm build && pnpm budget && pnpm deploy:check && pnpm build:e2e && pnpm e2e && pnpm a11y:stories
scripts.deploy:check: WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --config apps/run/wrangler.jsonc && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --config apps/web/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test:content: node tools/content/run-pipeline.mjs --check && python3 tools/content/pipeline.py --check && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_grader.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_explain.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_content_pipeline.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_readability.py' && node tools/tests/run-unittests-pyodide.mjs test_grader.py test_explain.py test_content_pipeline.py test_readability.py
